videos.title: Inside the Unprecedented SEC Bailout of Stocks & Crypto | Major Rule Change
videos.point: SEC innovation exemption lets 1:1 tokenized stocks trade on-chain for 5 years without exchange registration or best-execution — framed as a bailout after Clarity Act failed.
content: On-chain stock tokens, no exchange registration, no best bid/offer
Timing: ~2 days after Clarity Act failed
Benefits crypto rails and brokers (Robinhood called out)
videos.watch_why: Skip the first ~5 minutes; the rule is the payload.

videos.title: Iran Laughs "TRUMP WON'T DO IT"... Then Their Power Plants GET VAPORIZED
videos.point: Commentary packaging Trump threats to knock out Iranian power plants/bridges; title oversells that plants were already ‘vaporized.’
content: Trump: could take out power plants in a day / bridges in an hour
Framed as leverage in stalled talks
News-clip montage + opinion, not a battle damage report

videos.title: LIVE: Heavy Clashes In Iran - Anti-IRGC Armed Iranians Target More Cities
videos.point: Long live stream claiming armed anti-IRGC clashes spreading to more Iranian cities; treat as opposition-channel reporting, not verified wire copy.
content: Live geopolitical stream, ~46 minutes
Theme: internal armed resistance vs IRGC
Comments split on whether footage is overstated
videos.watch_why: 46-minute live. Only if you want raw stream, not a thesis.

videos.title: Trump Issues NEW WARNING | Iran Tankers Struck AGAIN
videos.point: Trump talking ‘annihilate’ / restart major strikes while tanker-for-tanker hits continue in Hormuz; Kevin treats louder threats as a tell.
content: Reports of additional tanker strikes + Bitbank sanctions
Axios: Trump approaching decision on restarting massive attacks
Markets/oil angle baked in

videos.title: What Happens to Your Body After Stopping Ozempic
videos.point: Off Ozempic: hunger/hormones rebound, muscle risk, keep protein + lifting + low-insulin eating if you want the weight to stay off.
content: GLP-1 off → ghrelin up, satiety signals normalize
Weight regain common if diet/training don’t change
Berg pitch: protein, resistance training, keto/IF
videos.watch_why: Short and on-topic if you care about coming off GLP-1. URL may need a fix if the watch id is wrong.

videos.title: IRGC Mobilizes 313,000 Troops As Trump Weighs MASSIVE Iran Strikes
videos.point: Tehran staged a ~313k ‘Janfada/Fedayeen for Iran’ parade while Trump publicly weighs restarting big strikes; mix of IRGC pageantry and munitions talk.
content: 313,000 is organizer figure + religious symbolism (313)
Trump: ‘big decision’ on resuming major attacks
Pilot commentary on bunkers/carriers; sponsored midroll
videos.watch_why: One useful fact (the rally). Rest is channel format.

videos.title: Victor Davis Hanson: "An Earth-Shattering Event Is Going To Happen In Iran..."
videos.point: VDH clip: after ~6 months of pressure he puts ~30% odds the Iranian street snaps; host wraps it for an audience.
content: Food/money stress + prior strikes as backdrop
Analogy: delayed collapse after a regime is militarily humiliated
Reaction-channel format around one Hanson clip
videos.watch_why: The Hanson bit is short; the rest is wrapper.
